Red 79

Being a player of a [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] - Clouds deck since Cloud City was released, I just though that I would share my views on a card that is frequently disregarded in favor of cheaper, more powerful Starfighters. The [[Medium Transport]] is Deploy 2, Forfeit 4, Power 1, Armor 3, Hyperspeed 4. At first glance, this is not too spectacular (especially in battle - heavy decks). But if you put this ship into a situation where it is unlikely to be battled (i.e. - the Clouds on [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]]) it begins to shine. The most common way that the Dark Side has to overrun the Clouds on [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]], is to move a Star Destroyer loaded with TIE's over to the [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] system, have the

TIE's move into the clouds, and start Tallon Rolling all the Starfighters that they can get their sights on. Because the [[Medium Transport]] is a Capital ship that moves and deploys like a Starfighter, it is immune to this silly tactic. It's Power works out to be the same as a Y-Wing (0), it suffers no penalties to it's Maneuver (it doesn't have one), it has a permanent pilot, and it's Forfeit is one better! If you're opponent is using [[Bounty]] Hunter ships (like Slave 1), then Deploy the Transport to [[Kessel]], put any Pilot main character (except [[Chewbacca]]) aboard, and you have a Destiny draw as well! Granted, it's not as powerful as Fett in Slave 1, but with [[Yoda]] on the Hut (as I'm sure you know) you'll be able to reduce the Attrition by 2, and your opponents Power will be -2 for being in the Clouds.

Because the Transport can deploy and move like a Starfighter, It can Deploy to a [[Cloud City: Platform 327 (Docking Bay){{!}}Docking Bay]], and land at Exterior Sites. This has come in handy for me several times, when an emergency evacuation is called for on [[Tatooine]], or when I want to deposit some characters on [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]], and have no Encampments or [[Great Warrior]]'s handy.

Finally, for a really big Power boost, deploy a [[Cloud Car]] into the belly of the Transport at [[Kessel]], and move it to [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]], and then into the Clouds. Drop off a few Cars this way, and guaranteed your opponent wont be aching to initiate a battle there.

Combo's

[[Medium Transport]] + Any Main = Destiny, and Forfeit fodder to boot.

[[Medium Transport]] + [[Cloud Car]] (repeatedly) = A good reason for the Dark Side not to invade the Clouds.

[[Medium Transport]] + R5M2 + Bo Shek = Power 5, Armor 3, immune to Attrition &lt; 3, immune to [[Tallon Roll]], and can draw Destiny! (A lot of cards, but I've done it, and in the Clouds no less!)<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/hoth/light/small/mediumtransport.html</ref>
